name: Defensive Coverage Redistribution v1

inherit.fixed_defender_ranks: D1-D10 by focal distance at t; canonical-ID tie break

coverage_consequence.name: mean distinct-defender geometric coverage cost
coverage_consequence.attacker_set: all nine non-focal attacking outfield players fixed at t
coverage_consequence.defender_set: all ten defending outfield players fixed at t
coverage_consequence.optimization: minimum-cost injective matching; one defender unused
coverage_consequence.matching_identity: descriptive only; no marking or responsibility semantics
coverage_consequence.endpoint_quantity: G_a(u)=mean matched distance across nine attackers
coverage_consequence.predicted_direction: positive means increased minimum distinct-defender matching distance

response_predictor.name: concurrent focal-local versus middle defender-relative path contrast

ball_role.model: none; observed ball path may be reported descriptively but does not determine eligibility

model.unit: one focal-attacker perspective at one period/time anchor
model.transformation: demean outcome and all columns within simultaneous-focal period/time anchor
model.estimand_units: metres coverage-cost change per metre response contrast

uncertainty.resampling: independent blocks within period; retain terminal partial blocks and complete anchor groups

focal_identity_permutation.method: nonzero cyclic shift of paired D and D_pre within canonical-ID-sorted focal rows at every anchor
focal_identity_permutation.pass: observed beta_D exceeds 95th percentile of permuted beta_D

remote_defender_comparator.pass: primary beta_D point estimate is greater than remote-comparator point estimate

focal_movement_trim.pass: trimmed beta_D positive and at least 50% absolute primary magnitude retained

synthetic_gates: perfect_compensation: high response and neutral coverage change
no_compensation: high response and positive coverage change
collective_translation: neutral response and coverage change
independent_other_attacker: coverage change without focal response
focal_ignored: neutral response and coverage change
multi_defender_collapse: high response and larger positive coverage change

classification.INVALID: frozen hash, sample/support, complete-set, geometry, full-rank, solver, bootstrap-minimum, synthetic-gate, or deterministic-serialization failure
classification.NOT_SUPPORTED: valid primary beta_D at or below zero
classification.COHERENT: valid beta_D above zero; 95% interval strictly above zero; focal permutation passes; primary exceeds remote comparator; frozen trim passes
classification.MIXED: every other valid execution with primary beta_D above zero

validation_sequence: Metrica Sample Game 1 development under separate authorization
consider separately frozen Game 2 heldout addendum only after Game 1 closure
consider IDSSE only after coherent within-provider evidence and provider-equivalent support
